name: Warehouse Enhancements
summary: Statistics Warehouses tab and warehouse Stocks card: slots, held slots, next cargo to fill, lines
description:
Shows what each warehouse really holds and which cargo needs action first. A warehouse is made of slots of 500, one per module; a slot holds one cargo at a time, and an empty slot takes any cargo of its kind. The game adds all slots together, so a warehouse can read 40 % while one cargo is full and can't be unloaded. Each feature can be turned off in the mod's Settings (the gear next to the mod when choosing a game's mods). Settings also has a Logging switch, off by default, that writes the mod's messages to the game log (stdout.txt) for bug reports.

Statistics Warehouses Tab: the statistics window's Warehouses tab shows every warehouse's slots as a strip of tiles, grouped by kind. A tile is green when one of your lines unloads that cargo there now, grey when none does, and red when the cargo is full. An outlined tile is a free slot, or one held for a cargo a line brings but that is out of stock right now; a filter icon marks a pinned slot. Hover a tile to see what it holds or takes. Free counts the slots nothing is held for, Next Full names the cargo that needs action first (no slot, a shared slot, loaded here but none brought, full, a pinned slot nothing is brought to, or the time until full), and the arrow column shows that cargo's change over the last year. Those problems are marked in the Problems column; click the mark to open the warehouse.

Warehouse Stocks Card: the warehouse window's Stocks card shows, for each cargo, its room, change a year and time until full; its icon is green when a line unloads it there and red on a problem, including a pinned cargo nothing is brought to and a cargo lines come to load that nothing brings (their load arrows in the lines list turn red too). When two cargos need the last free slot, both show in red, since whichever line arrives first takes it. The slot list says which slot is held for which cargo (click the cargo's icon to pin the slot to it), shows a red row for a cargo with no slot left, colours each slot's bar green when a line unloads its cargo there, and ends with the lines that unload or load at the warehouse; click one to open it.
